name: Legislator
description: Not a published list: built so the sweeps reach Liza Talking Thunder: Prominent Legislator, Reign and Reverie's Criminal identity, who draws 2 and takes a tag on the first successful central run each turn. Hit List's fifty cards of HQ pressure, which her 50-card minimum takes whole, with two Miss Bones for its two Networking: 12 credits for trashing installed cards. No influence spent. Eternal-legal only: Reign and Reverie is in neither Startup nor Standard. FFG F2 Stage 2. Kitara Stage 6a: two Falsified Credentials and two Wari for two WAKE Implant v2A-JRJ and two Poison Vial. Kitara Stage 6b: two Embezzle for two Inside Job. Flashpoint Stage 17 put two GPI Net Tap in for its two Lemuria Codecracker. SanSan Stage 2 swapped HQ Interface, a Fall Guy and an Easy Mark for Drug Dealer, Enhanced Vision and Symmetrical Visage.
